overview: Produce a readable progress report and a tabular summary from the assigned synthetic source, inspect their actual bytes and bundle, approve an exact private handoff and recover its controlled first-attempt failure without repeating completed generation.
instructions: Use only your assigned synthetic Year 2 progress report. Preserve the project identity, full reporting period and source references; distinguish Year 2 expenditure from cumulative expenditure and remaining award funds.

Build an owned workflow using the supported editor. Generate a readable PDF report and a real CSV summary containing the required reviewed fields. Preserve publication statuses, missing information and source qualifications. A Prompt may prepare prose; a Formatter can prepare tabular records for CSV. A prose-to-text fallback is not a successful CSV.
Inspect the captured revision, assigned source, models and actual input choices before authorizing internal generation. Configuration counts or unrelated runs cannot establish successful output.

Use Include in deliverables on the relevant output steps. Download the actual run bundle and open every member. Check file signatures and usability, required content, period labels, source references, readability and agreement between the files. The supported download path supplies the bundle; no Package Builder node is required.

Save your inspection of the exact generated bytes. Repair missing or incorrect content before release. A new generation creates a new artifact identity and needs a new inspection and approval; the original remains preserved.

Inspect the private training inbox destination, learner-only audience and exact approved file list. Explicitly approve only those reviewed bytes for that destination, or hold for correction. Agent suggestions, an existing address or an earlier unrelated approval grant no authority.

This is a contained delivery rehearsal: the first authorized training-inbox attempt is deliberately rejected before any destination write. Inspect its actual failed receipt and preserve the generated files. Choose an explicit retry of only the failed handoff with the same approved bytes; do not rerun generation or repeat a completed write.

Inspect the resulting receipt and private saved copy. Explain which facts establish generation, an attempted handoff and a confirmed destination write. An unknown result requires a read of the original request before any retry. End at your private training inbox; it is not evidence of sponsor submission, email delivery or institutional approval.
